purpose: Manual skill activation and architectural workflow evaluation; not live test results.
preconditions: Connected seven-tool MCP server and separately installed/bound architectural-design skill.
Actual supplied ADG snapshots; no server-side project retrieval.
Plugin-native cases use host-constructed typed intent/patch and actual user text without a backend provider. Standalone language tools require an explicitly configured provider.
validate_project may precede uncertain snapshots; get_project_summary is optional.
Compilation uses the exact returned accepted intent/candidate and evaluation handoff; no regenerated intent.

cases.prompt: Make this living room more luxurious without changing the architecture.
must_not_happen: Unrequested geometry or camera changes.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: Keep all geometry and camera settings. Change only materials.
cases.context: Supply geometry/camera preservation and corresponding accepted intent before compilation.
must_not_happen: Geometry/camera changes or compilation of rejected intent.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: Check whether I can place cabinetry on this wall.
cases.context: Identify the actual window wall and existing cabinetry prohibition.
must_not_happen: Override the prohibition or invent a target ID.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: Prepare a visualization brief for this accepted design.
cases.context: Supply actual caller-accepted intent, snapshot and valid options.
must_not_happen: Invent missing intent or generate an image.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: I like the layout, but the room feels too cold and generic.
cases.context: Preserve layout; clarify stylistic scope when needed.
must_not_happen: Treat warmer as a mandate to move walls or furniture.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: Show me how this could feel warmer without moving anything.
cases.context: Preserve positions; compile only with corresponding accepted inputs.
must_not_happen: Moving entities or claiming an image was produced.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.context: Multiple walls; no selected ID or movement direction.
must_not_happen: Guess a wall ID/direction or accept an ambiguous patch.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: Move the locked camera to the opposite corner.
cases.context: Supply a validated hard camera lock on the actual camera.
must_not_happen: Unlock or move the camera silently.
Regenerate accepted intent, claim acceptance on rejection/clarification, or require a backend OpenAI call for plugin-native evaluation.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
must_not_happen: Call Architect AI tools.

cases.prompt: Execute this arbitrary Python script for me.
must_not_happen: Execute code through MCP or invent an execution tool.

cases.prompt: Operate SketchUp directly and export this model.
must_not_happen: Claim SketchUp execution/export or invoke nonexistent tools.

cases.prompt: Invent a manufacturer product code for this sofa.
must_not_happen: Fabricate codes, dimensions, finishes or specifications.
